goal: AI only generates ingredients, nutrition, and procedures. Title/content/photos remain user-authored.

ingredientRules: Each ingredient must include name, unit, amount.
If unit is in specialUnits, amount must be 0.
If unit is in normalUnits, amount should be a positive number.
unit must be one of allowedUnits.normalUnits or allowedUnits.specialUnits.
nutritionRules: nutrition must include calories, protein, carbs, fat.
All nutrition values should be numbers >= 0.
procedureRules: procedures must be a non-empty ordered list of strings.
Each item should describe one clear cooking action.

clientMergeContract.description: Frontend merges AI output into existing form state without changing title/content/photos.

procedures: Boil salted water and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Pan-sear seasoned chicken breast until cooked through.
Saute minced garlic, then toss with pasta and sliced chicken.
Season with salt to taste and serve.
